fact: Designer 0.1 loads Draft, Compare, Respond, Reconcile, Synthesize, Confirm, or Consult for the active Work Turn.
In Draft, each of the three Designers receives the common taskbook, baseline, and fact snapshot and produces its own draft without seeing peer work.
In Compare, each Designer reads both frozen peer drafts and returns separate lists of proposed Goal or Fact changes addressed to their authors.
The plugin collects all three Compare results before delivering any change requests to draft authors.
In Respond, each Designer accepts or counters every request on its draft by issue and draft version.
In Reconcile, the plugin sends each counter to the other two Designers and collects their replies before returning them to the author.
Designer 0.1 pauses for a user decision when a full reconciliation returns a previously considered set of unresolved proposals.
In Synthesize, the Lead Designer incorporates the resolved issues into one implementation taskbook.
In Confirm, both Member Designers approve the exact implementation taskbook version produced by the Lead Designer or return specific unresolved issues.
The plugin advances to Implement after the Lead Designer and both Member Designers approve the same plan version and the plugin commits that version's taskbook.
After Design, the three Designer sessions keep their identity and wait without a model invocation until the plugin assigns another Work Turn.
A Designer entering Consult records the Work State and input version it will return to. An accepted answer goes into the next prompt for that Work State.
When the user resolves a Design issue, the plugin records the decision and resumes the affected round on the updated inputs.
